acceptance: HAVING/WHERE-alias variants unskipped where the inlined form passes compile-check on PG-DuckDB
context: Implemented on PR #2412, branch fix/tpchavoc-cloud-skip-sync, commit 577f82724. Added a cross-dialect, query-ID-aware rewrite dispatcher and inlined select-list aggregate aliases in HAVING/WHERE for PostgreSQL variants 3_v7, 4_v7, 5_v7, 7_v7, 9_v7, 10_v7, and 11_v7 while preserving ORDER BY aliases. Removed all seven execution skips, registered query-adapter rules for PG-DuckDB, PG-Mooncake, and TimescaleDB, updated validation mirrors and generated compatibility docs, and routed equivalence samples through the same production rewrite seam. Verification: Ruff passed; 27 focused tests passed; compat-docs and DDL drift checks passed. No local PostgreSQL service was reachable for an engine execution probe.
description: Postgres rejects select-list aliases in HAVING/WHERE (3_v7, 4_v7, 5_v7, 7_v7, 9_v7, 10_v7, 11_v7) but inlining the underlying aggregate expression is semantics-preserving. One rewrite pattern covers seven skips.
